# Khatario API Subscription & Authentication Security Audit

**Date:** 2026-06-06  
**Scope:** All `app/api/**/route.ts` handlers (587 files, 829 HTTP method handlers)  
**Framework:** Next.js App Router only (no Express routers, NestJS guards, or tRPC)

**Machine-readable full matrix:** `docs/SUBSCRIPTION_API_AUDIT.json` (generated by `node scripts/audit-subscription-protection.js`)

---

## Executive summary

| Layer | What it enforces | Subscription? |
|-------|------------------|-----------------|
| `middleware.ts` | JWT session cookie → `401` if missing/invalid; platform-admin paths; public allow-list | **No** — auth only |
| Route handlers | RBAC (`authorize`), features (`assertFeatureAccess`), reports (`assertReportAccess`), limits (`checkLimit` / `enforceAccess`) | **Opt-in per route** |

**Bottom line:** Subscription validation is **not global**. Roughly **50% of business API handlers** (365 / 730) have no server-side subscription/feature/limit check. A user with a **valid JWT** but **expired trial**, **expired subscription**, or **cancelled-at-period-end** (still `active` in DB until cron) can call any handler that only uses `authorize()` or no handler-level checks.

---

## Middleware inheritance chain

```
Request
  → middleware.ts (matcher: all non-static paths)
      → isStaticAsset? → pass
      → isPublicPath? → pass (no JWT)
      → isPlatformAdminProtectedPath? → platform JWT or 401
      → shouldRotateTokens (business JWT)
          → invalid JWT + /api/* → 401 (except offline catalog GET passthrough)
          → valid JWT → inject x-authenticated-user-id, x-authenticated-business-id, x-authenticated-session-version
  → app/api/**/route.ts handler
      → (optional) requireTenantBusinessId / getUserFromRequest / authorize / enforceAccess / assertFeatureAccess …
```

### Public API prefixes (`middleware.ts` lines 40–55)

No business JWT required:

- `/api/auth/login`, `/logout`, `/refresh`, `/impersonate`
- `/api/signup`
- `/api/admin/auth/login`, `/logout`
- `/api/cron/`
- `/api/webhooks/`, `/api/webhooks/platform-billing/`
- `/api/payments/webhook`
- `/api/health`
- `/api/public/`

Additional exceptions:

- `GET /api/admin/subscriptions/plans` (plan catalog)
- `GET /api/admin/reports` (sidebar route map — **unauthenticated**)
- Offline catalog GET passthrough with `LOCAL_SESSION_COOKIE` + query `user_id` + `business_id`

### Subscription-related code locations

| Symbol | File | Role |
|--------|------|------|
| `assertFeatureAccess` | `lib/subscription/feature-access.ts:252` | Throws `FeatureAccessDeniedError`; checks operational status, trial expiry, registry |
| `assertReportAccess` | `lib/subscription/feature-access.ts:610` | Maps report category → `reports_basic` / `reports_gst` / `reports_advanced` |
| `hasFeatureAccess` | `lib/subscription/feature-access.ts:421` | Non-throwing wrapper |
| `enforceAccess` | `lib/enforce-access.ts:53` | Subscription status + optional feature + `checkLimit` + branch |
| `checkLimit` / `checkLimitInTransaction` | `lib/subscription.ts` | Usage caps (invoices, customers, items, users, WhatsApp) |
| `isSubscriptionOperationalStatus` | `lib/subscription.ts:64` | `active` \| `trial` only |
| `checkTrialExpiry` | `lib/subscription/lifecycle.ts` | Trial grace handling inside `assertFeatureAccess` |
| `getHrRegistryFeatureForAuthModule` | `lib/hr-plan-features.ts` | HR modules get subscription check **inside** `authorize()` only |
| `hasWhatsAppBotAddon` | `lib/subscription.ts` | WhatsApp addon gate (used in WhatsApp routes + feature-access) |

**Not found:** `requireSubscription`, `subscriptionMiddleware`, `hasActiveSubscription` — naming uses the symbols above.

## Protection tiers

### Tier A — Fully protected (subscription + usually RBAC)

Handlers calling `assertFeatureAccess`, `assertReportAccess`, `enforceAccess`, `checkLimit`, or `hasWhatsAppBotAddon`.

**Examples:**

| Method | Route | Middleware chain | File |
|--------|-------|------------------|------|
| GET | `/api/reports/profit-loss` | JWT → `assertReportAccess` → `authorize` | `app/api/reports/profit-loss/route.ts:52–59` |
| POST | `/api/purchases` | JWT → `enforceAccess` + feature + limit → `authorize` | `app/api/purchases/route.ts` |
| POST | `/api/recurring-invoices` | JWT → `assertFeatureAccess(RECURRING_INVOICES)` | `app/api/recurring-invoices/route.ts:75` |
| POST | `/api/invoices` | JWT → `enforceAccess` (limit) → `authorize` | `app/api/invoices/route.ts` |
| POST | `/api/whatsapp/campaigns` | JWT → `hasWhatsAppBotAddon` | `app/api/whatsapp/campaigns/route.ts:141–147` |
| POST | `/api/backup/create` | JWT → `assertFeatureAccess(BACKUP_RESTORE)` | `app/api/backup/create/route.ts` |

Most `/api/reports/**` routes (~80+) use `assertReportAccess`. Most WhatsApp CRM routes use addon checks.

### Tier B — Partially protected

**B1 — RBAC only (`authorize`), no subscription feature/status check**

Expired/cancelled accounts with valid JWT can still use these unless UI blocks them.

| Method | Route | Risk | File |
|--------|-------|------|------|
| GET/POST | `/api/work-orders` | Paid module; no plan gate | `app/api/work-orders/route.ts:34–36, 126–128` |
| GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE | `/api/accounts` | Ledger; RBAC only | `app/api/accounts/route.ts:39, 185` |
| GET | `/api/gst/outstanding` | GST; RBAC only | `app/api/gst/outstanding/route.ts:48–49` |
| GET/POST | `/api/budgets` | Financial planning | `app/api/budgets/route.ts` |
| GET/POST | `/api/tds/*` | TDS module | `app/api/tds/**/route.ts` |
| GET/POST | `/api/commission-rules` | HR/sales | `app/api/commission-rules/route.ts` |

**B2 — JWT middleware only; weak or missing RBAC**

| Method | Route | Risk | File |
|--------|-------|------|------|
| GET/PATCH | `/api/settings/warehouses` | No `authorize`; `business_id` from query | `app/api/settings/warehouses/route.ts:10–20` |
| GET/POST | `/api/journal-entries/templates` | No `authorize`; `business_id` from query | `app/api/journal-entries/templates/route.ts:11–22` |
| GET | `/api/cloud-storage/google/auth` | No `authorize`; `business_id` from query | `app/api/cloud-storage/google/auth/route.ts:11–20` |
| GET | `/api/cloud-storage/google/callback` | OAuth callback; no feature gate | `app/api/cloud-storage/google/callback/route.ts` |

**B3 — Core/free features (correct to skip feature gate, but no operational-subscription gate on GET)**

Invoices, customers, items, payments, dashboard — use `authorize` and/or `checkLimit` on mutations; reads often have no subscription status check.

**B4 — HR routes via `authorize()`**

Subscription checked **only** for modules mapped in `getHrRegistryFeatureForAuthModule` (`lib/authorization.ts:157–178`). Other HR endpoints may use `authorize('employees', …)` without registry feature mapping.

### Tier C — Unprotected / misconfigured

| Issue | Route | Detail | File |
|-------|-------|--------|------|
| Attendance API blocked for kiosk users | `POST /api/attendance/send-otp` etc. | Not in `PUBLIC_API_PREFIXES`; kiosk page calls without JWT → **401 from middleware** | `middleware.ts`, `app/api/attendance/send-otp/route.ts` |
| WhatsApp Meta webhook | `POST /api/whatsapp/webhook` | Not public in middleware; handler has HMAC verify but middleware may 401 first | `app/api/whatsapp/webhook/route.ts:31–37` |
| Unauthenticated admin report map | `GET /api/admin/reports` | Explicitly bypasses auth in middleware | `middleware.ts:141–143` |
| Debug endpoints | `/api/subscriptions/debug`, `/api/subscriptions/addons/debug` | Authenticated business users; expose subscription internals | `app/api/subscriptions/debug/route.ts` |

## Critical gaps: paid features without server-side subscription check

**52 route paths** in premium modules lack `assertFeatureAccess` / `assertReportAccess` / `enforceAccess` / addon checks (see JSON for full list).

| Module | Example routes | Recommended fix | Primary file(s) |
|--------|----------------|-----------------|-----------------|
| Chart of accounts / ledger | `/api/accounts`, `/api/ledger/**` | `assertFeatureAccess(businessId, FeatureKeys.LEDGER_ACCOUNTING)` | `app/api/accounts/route.ts`, `app/api/ledger/route.ts` |
| JE templates | `/api/journal-entries/templates` | `authorize` + `LEDGER_ACCOUNTING` | `app/api/journal-entries/templates/route.ts` |
| GST utilities | `/api/gst/gstr2b/**`, `/api/gst/outstanding` | `assertReportAccess(..., 'gst')` or GST feature key | `app/api/gst/gstr2b/*/route.ts` |
| Bank statements | `/api/bank-statements/**` | Feature for bank recon / advanced accounting | `app/api/bank-statements/import/route.ts` |
| Budgets | `/api/budgets` | Advanced reporting / ledger feature | `app/api/budgets/route.ts` |
| TDS | `/api/tds/**` | Plan feature (if gated in UI) | `app/api/tds/categories/route.ts` |
| Work orders | `/api/work-orders` | Add registry feature + `assertFeatureAccess` | `app/api/work-orders/route.ts` |
| Cloud backup OAuth | `/api/cloud-storage/google/auth` | `FeatureKeys.BACKUP_RESTORE` before OAuth | `app/api/cloud-storage/google/auth/route.ts` |
| Multi-warehouse settings | `/api/settings/warehouses` | `FeatureKeys.MULTI_WAREHOUSE` + `requireTenantBusinessId` | `app/api/settings/warehouses/route.ts` |
| Supplier hub | `/api/suppliers/hub/**` | Supplier/plan feature | `app/api/suppliers/hub/directory/route.ts` |
| Offline replay | `POST /api/offline-sync/replay` | Operational subscription + limits | `app/api/offline-sync/replay/route.ts` |
| PO sub-resources | `/api/purchase-orders/[id]/*` | Same as `POST /api/purchase-orders` (parent has checks) | `app/api/purchase-orders/[id]/route.ts` |

## Expired trial / subscription bypass

`assertFeatureAccess` (`lib/subscription/feature-access.ts:277–310`) rejects:

- Missing subscription → `NO_SUBSCRIPTION`
- Non-operational status (`expired`, `cancelled`) → `SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE` / `SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED`
- Trial past grace → `SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED`
- Past `end_date` → `SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED`

**Routes that do NOT call this (or `enforceAccess`) do not get these checks.** Middleware still accepts JWT until session revoked.

**Frontend-only gating:** Sidebar/plan locks in React (`useCapability`, `LayoutDataContext`, `SubscriptionUsageBanner`) — bypassable via direct `fetch('/api/...')` with session cookie.

---

## Recommended fixes (priority order)

1. **Global operational subscription middleware helper** — Add `requireOperationalSubscription(request)` in `lib/enforce-access.ts` and call from a shared wrapper or at top of mutating handlers (403 if not `active`/`trial` or trial expired).
2. **Central route wrapper** — `withBusinessApi(handler, { feature?, limit?, module?, action? })` composing `requireTenantBusinessId` + `enforceAccess` + `authorize`.
3. **Fix Tier C misconfigurations** — Add `/api/attendance/*` and `/api/whatsapp/webhook` to public prefixes with handler-level OTP/HMAC verification.
4. **Close Tier B2 IDOR gaps** — Replace query-param `business_id` with `requireTenantBusinessId(request)` on settings, templates, cloud-storage auth.
5. **Sweep Tier B1 premium modules** — Ledger, TDS, budgets, work-orders, bank-statements, GST utilities.
6. **Remove or restrict debug routes** in production (`/api/subscriptions/debug`).
7. **Automated CI** — Extend `scripts/audit-subscription-protection.js` to fail CI when paid-route patterns lack subscription symbols.

## Automated test matrix

Use staging with six fixture businesses (or DB seeds). All requests use `credentials: 'include'` unless “No token”.

| Scenario | Setup | Expected on protected route | Expected on unprotected route |
|----------|-------|----------------------------|------------------------------|
| **1. No token** | Clear cookies | `401` `{ code: 'UNAUTHENTICATED' }` | Public/cron: `200`/handler logic |
| **2. Valid token, free plan** | Free plan, active | Feature-gated: `403` `FEATURE_NOT_IN_PLAN` | Core CRUD: `200`/`201` within limits |
| **3. Expired subscription** | `status='expired'` | `assertFeatureAccess` routes: `403` `SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED` | `authorize`-only routes: **may still `200` (bug)** |
| **4. Expired trial (no grace)** | Trial past `trial_end_date` | `403` on feature routes | Same bypass as #3 on RBAC-only |
| **5. Cancelled (cancel_at_period_end, still active)** | Active until `end_date` | Allowed until period end (by design) | Allowed |
| **6. Active paid plan** | Business+ with feature enabled | `200`/`201` | `200` |

### Sample test cases (curl / Playwright)

```http
# 1) No token — should 401
GET /api/reports/profit-loss?business_id={uuid}

# 2) Free plan — advanced report should 403
GET /api/reports/profit-loss?business_id={uuid}   Cookie: session=...

# 3) Expired trial — recurring invoices POST should 403
POST /api/recurring-invoices  Body: { business_id, ... }

# 4) Expired trial — work orders POST may incorrectly 201 (document if so)
POST /api/work-orders  Body: { business_id, created_by, ... }

# 5) Journal templates — IDOR test: wrong business_id in query vs session
GET /api/journal-entries/templates?business_id={other_business_uuid}

# 6) WhatsApp campaign without addon — 403
POST /api/whatsapp/campaigns

# 7) Attendance OTP from clean browser (no portal cookie) — expect 401 today
POST /api/attendance/send-otp  Body: { phone, business_id }
```

Suggested test file location: `tests/security/subscription-api-access.spec.ts` (not yet implemented).
